categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the Wallet label and fixes PSBT signing key resolution in DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where FillPSBT fails to produce complete signatures on owned inputs when witness_utxo and non_witness_utxo conflict. While fixing inconsistencies between FillPSBT and SignPSBTInput improves PSBT reliability, inputs containing conflicting UTXO data represent an edge case that is reasonably deferrable.
